name: Peru (Reglamento Nacional de Edificaciones: E.030, E.060)
description: Peru's National Building Regulations (alpha 9 track C24), a pack that extends the US pack aci318-asce7-22. Seismic by E.030 2018 (Diseño Sismorresistente): the zone factor Z (0.45, 0.35, 0.25, 0.10 for zones 4-1), the soil profiles S0-S3 with the soil factor S by zone and soil (Table 3) and the periods TP and TL (Table 4), the use factor U (1.5, 1.3, 1.0), the amplification C = 2.5 below TP, 2.5 TP/T to TL, 2.5 TP TL/T² beyond (1 + 7.5 T/TP below 0.2 TP for the modal analysis), Sa = Z U C S / R with R = R0 Ia Ip (regular buildings, Ia = Ip = 1), C/R at least 0.11, T = hn / CT (35, 45, 60), the drift limits by material (concrete 0.007, steel 0.010, masonry 0.005) with 0.75 R times the elastic displacements, by the generic shapeFactors spectrum method with its soil factors. Concrete by E.060 (ACI 318 with the Peruvian load combinations 1.4D + 1.7L, 1.25(D + L) ± E, 0.9D ± E and strength reduction factors 0.70 tied columns, 0.85 shear) on the base pack's ACI 318-19 rules, the bars named in inches as sold in Peru; steel E.090 as the base pack's AISC 360-22; live loads E.020 as the base pack's ASCE 7-22 values; the towns' wind speeds the E.020 least 75 km/h. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the towns' zones and the system values are to be checked before design.
